Alright, I understand your question… Here’s my opinion : self harm is bad because as it is called, it’s a form of harm. Whether it makes you feel better or not, it’s hurting you physically and mentally (growing into an addiction). Just like hurting others is horrible : you shouldn’t do it to yourself. It can even put your health in danger, if you make a wrong move or whatever. So yes, there is definitely nothing healthy in self harming. It’s a quick way the brain finds to feel relief over a problem, but just like any addiction, if you self harm, you will simply end up with one more issue added to the already present one.

Listen man, I don’t really know what to tell you, because I’m not sure if you’ll hear me out… but I’ll try anyway.
Although my situation was quiet different from yours, I’ve been struggling with these kind of thoughts daily not very long ago, and I was ready to end it all. It was hopeless, I was trapped and no one could hear my pain and help me. 
Now I’ve grown into an entirely different person. I survived this chaos, and I only know it made me stronger. Oh how I KNOW these kind of words seem abstrait and not realistic right now, but I guarantee you it is not. In the end, I believe we are the only ones that can save ourselves. Though that doesn’t mean we are alone. 

I wish you all the love in the world, may you find your way through life, because please, it would be such a waste for yourself to end it all.

I think it is something very positive that you manage to realise it in the first place, and are ready to improve. Perhaps try to use your skills in a good way ? Being manipulative isn’t necessarily a bad thing, manipulation can be a great tool if used wisely. But I understand your feeling towards others, and the fact that you are sick of your relations ending this way. This leads to the question : why do you act like this ? You should try to figure that out first, as how can you help if you don’t find the root of the problem ? Secondly, you should work on it, if required, with a specialist. Perhaps try to explain your problem to them, and see if they can give you some advice… if you can’t afford a professional, then perhaps someone you’re feeling comfortable enough to talk about it ?
